svg.title: The creator adds a second timeline lane
svg.desc: Add a separate public-wiki lane beneath the existing incident timeline on the creator's desk. Preserve the earlier lane intact rather than rewriting it around the new report. Visual distinction: Two separated calendar rails with a wide blank middle gutter and aligned edge ticks. Supports dated comparison without links, shared identities, or additional event marks.
